fieldNotes.buildingId: Confirmed Niagara via the 'niagara' wordmark on the east building face and a Niagara monument sign at the east entrance (Street View, captured 2026-03). ~600,000 sq ft single-story concrete tilt-up plant, operational 2023, 5959 Arch Rd.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Fully fenced site (black metal perimeter fence). The SE truck/yard entrance has a wide rolling chain-link gate across the driveway - clearly visible in 2026-03 Street View. A second gated driveway exists at the NE corner.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth beside either gate - just the rolling gates. Open driveway with gate but no staffed structure.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present, no guard shack -> remote check-in (kiosk / call-box / app). Standard for this newer 2023 plant.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate apron and a deep, wide north dock yard - ample paved width to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long canopied dock run along the north face plus additional doors on the SW face; estimated ~45 - band 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Deep, wide paved trailer yard along the north face holds many dropped trailers; band 50+.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs in a corridor NW of the building but there is NO spur into the property - the north dock face is truck docks only.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: SE Stockton industrial logistics district - dense cluster of big-box distribution buildings, within the Stockton metro. Called Urban; borderline edge-of-town - flagged.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~41 acres from the perimeter box (large 600k-sq-ft plant + north dock yard + east employee parking).
